referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Wind turbine foundation, at site including manufacturing, transports, installation, replacements, decommission and waste treatement. Calculated for FU of 1p. Data are based on the plant IEA reference 3.4MW onshore wind turbine (Bortolotti et al., 2019; Cooperman et al., 2023). Assumed lifetime is 25 years.
referenceFunction.name: Wind turbine 3.4MW, onshore, foundation
